title: Synergistic interface design of Al2O3-coated NMC811 and graphitic-based pre-lithiated anodes for enhanced full-cell performance
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01604E, Paper
Ebru Doğan, Rawdah Whba, Iqra Moeez, Kyung Yoon Chung, Ece Unur Yilmaz, Emine Altin, Mehmet Nurullah Ates, Serdar Altın
This study investigated aluminum oxide (Al2O3) surface coatings on lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide (NMC811) cathodes using a wet chemical process based on ethanol-dissolved aluminum ethoxide (Al(OEt)3).
